independence: A second same-agent reconstruction from rendered primary pages and a mean/zero-sum operator derivation. Shared source, agent and known target; no fresh referee independence is claimed. The B implementation does not read input A or A outputs.

operator.action: negative second derivative on each metric interval, unweighted Lebesgue measure
operator.source_derivative_convention: into the vertex: -f'(0) at an origin, +f'(L) at a terminus
operator.form: q(f)=sum integral |f_e'|^2, domain continuous edgewise H1
operator.positivity: q>=0; on a connected compact graph the kernel consists of constants

pumpkin.reversed_coordinates: y=1-x, directed physical v2->v1 on every edge
pumpkin.coefficient_map: alpha_e=c a_e+s b_e; beta_e=s a_e-c b_e. This is an involution when c^2+s^2=1.
pumpkin.derived_sectors: Common-edge mean is a Neumann interval of length 1. The E-1 dimensional zero-sum edge sector has Dirichlet values at both endpoints.
pumpkin.derived_spectrum: Zero simple; every (n pi)^2, n>=1, has one common Neumann mode plus E-1 zero-sum Dirichlet modes, total multiplicity E.
pumpkin.row_map_to_A: Swap the two continuity blocks and swap the two flux rows; negate both flux rows. Apply the coefficient map on every edge.

split_tree.render_derived_lengths: a=1/2; stems of length h=epsilon; m identical fan leaf edges of length b=atan(cot(pi h)/m)/pi
split_tree.orientation: Use leaf-to-hub coordinate z=b-x on each fan leaf; stem coordinate r starts at v0
split_tree.leaf_basis: C cos(kz), which imposes the leaf Neumann condition before matching
split_tree.hub_flux: m C sin(k b)=S cos(k h)
split_tree.pole_free_fan_matrix_order: unknowns S,C; rows [-sin(k h),cos(k b)] and [-cos(k h),m sin(k b)]
split_tree.pole_free_fan_characteristic: cos(k h) cos(k b)-m sin(k h) sin(k b)=0
split_tree.length_relation: tan(pi b)=cot(pi h)/m; equivalently m tan(pi h) tan(pi b)=1
split_tree.perturbation: b changes to b+eta, eta>0; h and a fixed
split_tree.limits: The finite-instance calculation does not establish uniform epsilon control of a doubled construction.

uniform_doubling.transformed_domain: g is continuous across original vertices and has standard Kirchhoff flux; every h_e belongs to H2(0,L_e) intersect H1_0(0,L_e), independently of other edges
uniform_doubling.operator_identity: U H_doubled U^-1 = H_original direct_sum (direct_sum over edges of H_Dirichlet,(0,L_e))
uniform_doubling.full_antisymmetric_spectrum: For each original edge e, every (n pi/L_e)^2 for n>=1 is retained. Coincident eigenvalues add multiplicities.
uniform_doubling.zero_sector: No Dirichlet zero mode; symmetric zero is the connected graph constant
uniform_doubling.conditions: Uniform doubling of every edge, equal lengths within each pair, standard unweighted Kirchhoff domain; no potential, magnetic phase, delta coupling or changed conductivity
